claims.statement: The CBAM definitive regime began on 1 January 2026 and generally covers importers above a 50-tonne threshold.
The Commission registry lets non-EU operators upload emissions data once and share it confidentially with declarants.

contrary_evidence: The official registry already enables reusable sharing and the threshold excludes many small importers.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: Polish customs brokers above the threshold.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1200 importers at 9000 PLN annually exceed 10 million PLN ARR and support founder equity above 5 million PLN in six years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15-20 hours weekly with outsourced onboarding.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: one broker portfolio within six months.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1000-5000 PLN monthly plus 200-800 PLN per supplier mapping.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: annual declarations and supplier changes recur.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Consented supplier mappings serve multiple buyers and exceptions enrich rules
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Secure evidence relay sold by subscription and mapping fee
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The broker pays on supplier onboarding and declaration preparation
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An importer needs verified embedded-emissions evidence

founder_fit: Rules automation fits the founder, although cross-border onboarding adds social load.
risks: The product may be a dispensable interface.

structure.control_point: A permissioned graph of installations, goods, verification evidence, importers, and resolved exceptions
structure.critical_dependency: Supplier and verifier participation without duplicating the official registry

thesis: A supplier-side CBAM evidence relay securely reuses verified installation data across customs brokers and importers while learning recurring exception resolutions.
title: Carbon Relay
uncertainties: Official-registry gaps and broker demand are unvalidated.
